{{Quote|Those are, what, those asteroid ships we helped him get from Stonehill Industries?|Leia tries to identify a group of mole miners|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Asteroid ships''' were a type of vehicle in use during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once helped [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] acquire a number of asteroid ships from the company, [[Stonehill Industries]], which he then used for tug work in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
